title: Delicious Chinese-Style Wrap
description: A tasty and easy-to-make wrap packed with Chinese flavors, wrapped in a British-style wrap. Perfect for a quick snack or light meal.

ingredients.name: Yummy
ingredients.notes: Chopped or sliced to your liking

instructions: Preheat a pan over medium heat.
Place the wrap in the pan and warm for 1-2 minutes.
Add the yummy and cook for 2-3 minutes, until heated through.
Add a large leaf and fold the wrap to create a wrap.
